messages:
DevOps Bot: PAGER: embeddings-queue-p99 spike in eu-west detected (alert: embeddings_queue_p99 > 450ms) — firing to eng-oncall. Link: https://metrics.redwood/internal/alerts/embeddings_queue_p99 :rotating_light:
Maya R: taking primary for this evening handoff, pulling context. saw multiple small customer errors reported via SRE-sentry but not full outage. :eyes:
Maya R: current state: p99 for embed requests in eu-west ~ 520ms, throughput steady, queue length up from 40 -> 180 in last 10m. origin appears to be a routing hotpath to embeddings-consumer-1 (gpu pool).
Kevin L: I'm secondary for the next 2h. I can own customer comms and escalation to infra if this crosses 10% customer error rate.
Maya R: quick checklist run: prometheus query -> `rate(redwood_embeddings_queue_length[5m])` trending up; `sum(rate(embeddings_consumer_errors_total[5m])) by (region)` shows small bump in eu-west.
Alex H: I ran the warmup script earlier — no recent deployments to embeddings. worth checking node evictions? `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=app=embeddings-consumer`
Maya R: running diag now: `kubectl exec -n inference -c metrics embeddings-consumer-1 -- curl -s localhost:9090/health` -> OK. KV-cache hit rate slightly lower: 91% -> 84% which explains more backend work.
Maya R: mitigation attempted 1: scaled embeddings-consumer from 4 -> 8 replicas. monitor for 5m.
DevOps Bot: Scale job queued: infra-scaler acknowledged, scaling embeddings-consumer to 8 replicas (job id: scale-7891).
Sara P: FYI capacity note: eu-west gpu pool has 2 spare nodes, scaling to >10 may spike autoscaler lead time ~ 90s. If we need >12, ping infra-oncall.
Maya R: after scale to 8 (3m): p99 dropped to ~380ms, queue shrank to ~60. improvement observed but still above baseline 220ms.
Kevin L: customer impact status: 2 customers reported slow responses via support slack, no 5xx observed. flagging as 'degraded' in statuspage draft. I'll prepare a brief note if trend continues.
Maya R: mitigation 2 (in play if p99 > 450ms again): enable spillover to cpu-embeddings fallback (lower perf but reduces latency tail). runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings/fallback. Steps: 1) toggle routing flag `embeddings.route.fallback=true` in configstore 2) trigger traffic-split via routing service.
Alex H: command snippet: ```bash
# enable fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://config.redwood/v1/flags -d '{"key":"embeddings.route.fallback","value":true}'
# split 10% traffic
curl -X POST https://routing.redwood/api/v1/split -d '{"service":"embeddings","split":10,"target":"cpu-embeddings"}'
```
Maya R: runbook pointers also mention KV-prefetch warmup: `scripts/prefetch_embeddings.sh --region eu-west` — doing a warm prefetch now.
DevOps Bot: Incident created: INC-2023-847 (embeddings-high-p99-eu-west). Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2023-847
Maya R: handoff notes for incoming oncall: primary = Maya R (me), secondary = Kevin L. If I go offline, Kevin picks primary. coverage gap: midnight shift (00:00-04:00 UTC) has no infra-oncall overlap — if autoscaling quirks require infra escalation, please call +1-555-0119 (oncall pager) and escalate via #infra-oncall.
Maya R: open actions: 1) monitor p99 and queue for next 30m 2) if p99 back under 300ms, close alert and add postmortem note 3) if p99 > 500ms for 10m -> enable fallback and notify infra 4) Kevin to draft status page if customer reports increase.
Kevin L: I'll draft the status update template: short summary + mitigation steps + ETA for next update (15m).
Sara P: ops note: afterscale, GC churn increased on a couple pods; watching memory OOM risk — may need node-replacement if OOM enters.
Maya R: logs grep I ran: `kubectl logs -n inference embeddings-consumer-2 | grep -i "timeout\|reject"` -> handful of timeouts to kv-store between 22:03-22:06, likely transient. added to incident timeline.
Maya R: leaving this thread for handoff at 22:20 UTC. last metrics snapshot attached: p99 365ms, queue 48. If pager fires again, escalate to infra-oncall and run fallback. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: acknowledged. I'll be watching and will post any customer comms. signing on until 00:30 UTC.
DevOps Bot: Reminder set: follow-up check at 22:35 UTC (automated).
